guideContent.strategyOverview: Four-color proliferate midrange that wins primarily through poison counters. The deck deploys cheap toxic and infect creatures in the first two turns to seed initial poison counters, then uses Atraxa's automatic end-step proliferate plus a dense suite of proliferate triggers to scale those counters toward lethal. Atraxa herself is a value engine, not a win condition — her flying, deathtouch, and lifelink make her an excellent attacker and blocker, while her proliferate advances the poison plan incrementally. The deck functions without the commander: toxic creatures like Bloated Contaminator and Venerated Rotpriest apply poison independently, and Triumph of the Hordes can close games with any board. Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus doubles all proliferate triggers, turning Atraxa's end-step tick into +2 poison on every opponent. Necrogen Rotpriest adds an extra poison counter whenever any toxic creature connects, dramatically accelerating the clock. The interaction suite runs the full B4 package — Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Deadly Rollick, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge — protecting the board and disrupting opponents. Multiple removal spells double as poison delivery (Whisper of the Dross proliferates, Infectious Bite gives each opponent a poison counter). Corrupted payoffs (Skrelv's Hive lifelink, Contaminant Grafter card draw, Glistening Sphere triple mana) reward the deck for doing what it already wants to do. Win path: seed poison T1-3 via small toxic/infect creatures, establish Atraxa + proliferate engine T3-5, close by T6-7 via accumulated poison or Triumph of the Hordes.

winConditions.title: Proliferate Poison Accumulation
winConditions.description: The primary win path. Seed initial poison counters via small toxic/infect creatures, then proliferate every turn with Atraxa's end step trigger. Tekuthal doubles each proliferate instance, scaling poison +2 per end step. Inexorable Tide adds proliferate on every spell cast. With multiple proliferate sources active, opponents reach 10 poison in 3-4 turn cycles without needing additional combat damage.

winConditions.title: Triumph of the Hordes
winConditions.description: The finisher. With any board of 3+ creatures, Triumph gives +1/+1, trample, and infect to all creatures. A board of Atraxa + 2 toxic creatures represents 10+ infect damage with trample, killing one player outright. If opponents already have 5-7 poison from earlier turns, even partial damage through blockers is lethal after the next proliferate step.

winConditions.title: Corrupted Conscience Theft
winConditions.description: Steal an opponent's largest creature and give it infect. Their 10/10 now kills players in a single swing via poison. Especially devastating when used on an opponent's commander or Eldrazi titan. The stolen creature also benefits from Atraxa's proliferate advancing any poison it deals.

winConditions.title: Vorinclex + Vraska Instant Kill
winConditions.description: With Vorinclex on the battlefield, cast Vraska for 6 mana. She enters with 12 loyalty counters (6 base doubled by Vorinclex). Activate her -9 ability targeting an opponent — they receive 9 poison counters, doubled to 18 by Vorinclex. Instant kill regardless of board state or life total. Only requires 2 cards + 12 mana total.

winConditions.title: Necrogen Rotpriest Toxic Overload
winConditions.description: Necrogen Rotpriest adds an extra poison counter whenever any toxic creature deals combat damage. With a board of 3-4 toxic creatures (including mite tokens from Skrelv's Hive), each combat step delivers 6-8 poison counters to a single opponent. Bloated Contaminator's trample ensures damage connects, and its combat-damage proliferate triggers scale all existing poison.

synergies.title: Double Proliferate
synergies.description: Tekuthal doubles Atraxa's end-step proliferate from 1 to 2. Every turn, all opponents gain +2 poison counters passively. With even a single initial poison counter on each opponent, this represents a 5-turn clock with zero additional interaction required.

synergies.title: Spell-Triggered Poison
synergies.description: Skrelv's activated ability targets a creature you control, triggering Venerated Rotpriest's ability to give an opponent a poison counter. Repeatable every turn for W/P (or 2 life). Seeds poison without needing to attack, enabling Corrupted payoffs early.

synergies.title: Toxic Lord Package
synergies.description: Necrogen Rotpriest gives all toxic creatures an extra poison counter on combat damage. Hand of the Praetors gives all infect creatures +1/+1 and triggers a free poison counter when casting infect creatures. Together they amplify the output of every threat in the deck.

synergies.title: Proliferate Combat Package
synergies.description: Three creatures that proliferate on combat damage. With flying (Thrummingbird, Grateful Apparition) or trample (Bloated Contaminator), they reliably connect. Each hit both deals toxic/infect damage and proliferates existing poison on all opponents. Multiple attackers compound the effect.

synergies.title: Landfall Proliferate
synergies.description: Evolution Sage proliferates on every land drop, turning fetch lands into double proliferate triggers (sac fetch = landfall #1, find land = landfall #2). Sword of Truth and Justice adds a +1/+1 counter then proliferates on combat damage, scaling both poison and creature power.

synergies.title: Removal + Value
synergies.description: Interaction spells that also advance the poison plan. Whisper ({B}) kills creatures and proliferates. Infectious Bite ({1}{G}) uses your creature to fight an opponent's creature while giving each opponent a poison counter. Vraska's Fall ({2}{B}) forces opponents to sacrifice and gives each a poison counter. Every removal spell is also a poison accelerant.

synergies.title: Corrupted Payoffs
synergies.description: Once any opponent has 3+ poison: Skrelv's Hive grants lifelink to all toxic creatures, sustaining aggressive attacks. Contaminant Grafter draws a card and plays a free land each end step. Glistening Sphere taps for 3 mana of one color instead of 1. The deck is rewarded for executing its natural game plan.

synergies.title: Ichor Rats Seed
synergies.description: Ichor Rats gives every player a poison counter on ETB — including you, but Atraxa's proliferate targets only opponents. This immediately enables Corrupted for all opponents and starts Atraxa's proliferate clock from turn 1 of having her in play.

synergies.title: Burst Proliferate Finisher
synergies.description: Expansion Algorithm proliferates X times for {X}{U}{U}. With Tekuthal on the battlefield, each proliferate instance is doubled. At X=3 (5 mana total): 6 proliferate triggers, adding +6 poison to every opponent. At X=5 (7 mana): 10 proliferate triggers — lethal from just 1 existing poison counter. Vorinclex doubles the counters placed by each proliferate, making even small X values devastating.

synergies.title: Vorinclex Poison Doubler
synergies.description: Vorinclex doubles every counter placed — including poison from infect/toxic creatures and proliferate triggers. Atraxa's end-step proliferate becomes +2 poison per opponent. With Vraska, Vorinclex enables a 2-card instant kill: Vraska enters with 12 loyalty (6 base doubled), activate -9 to give an opponent 9 poison counters doubled to 18. Opponent dies on the spot.
